claims.claim_text: D-Wave claims to have demonstrated 'quantum supremacy on a useful, real-world problem' in March 2025, published peer-reviewed in Science, using 1,200 qubit Advantage2 annealing prototype that would have taken classical supercomputers ~one million years.
claims.subject: D-Wave Quantum Inc.
claims.object_value: quantum supremacy demonstration on real-world problem with 1,200-qubit Advantage2
claims.source_quote: In March 2025, D-Wave became the first company in the world to demonstrate quantum supremacy on a useful, real-world problem. This groundbreaking work, which was achieved using our 1,200 qubit Advantage2 annealing quantum computing prototype, was published in a peer-reviewed paper in the esteemed journal, Science.

claims.claim_text: D-Wave reported GAAP revenue of $24.6 million for FY 2025 vs $8.8M FY 2024 (~180% YoY growth), with sources including QCaaS subscriptions, professional services, and on-premises Advantage2 system sales.
claims.subject: D-Wave Quantum Inc.

claims.claim_text: D-Wave raised approximately $779.1 million in net cash from financing activities in FY2025, completing 100% of FOUR at-the-market programs ($100M, $75M, $150M, $400M) and warrant-exercise inflows of $202.9M — a massive dilution episode while quarterly losses widened.

claims.source_quote: Net cash provided by financing activities during the year ended December 31, 2025 was $779.1 million, an increase of $596.7 million from $182.5 million for the year ended December 31, 2024. ...
